title: RSA run 2
summary: Seven inner-loop cells on Sherlock, 7-8 October 2026: the combined reference-game data (5 sources, 40k training trials) three times for 8 rounds, and two recovery conditions twice each for 4 rounds, with a ground-truth model withheld from the seeds. 6 Gemini 3.8 Flash agents per round, with no network access; models ranked, pruned and exported on grouped 5-fold CV over training conditions; live-set cap 12.
findings: Claim 1 holds in all three real cells: the exported model beats rsa_l2 on held-out conditions by +84.3 (SE 35.7), +56.2 (24.1) and +26.4 (13.1) lpd, about 2-2.4 clustered SE each, almost all of it on pragmods and Sikos 2021 (Mayn & Demberg within 2.2 lpd of rsa_l2).

CV selection exported models that generalise better than run 1's: held-out ranks 2/58, 8/57 and 11/58 (run 1: 26/40, 4/40), and the live sets stayed at 12 models, holding the top held-out models in two of three cells.
Real cells kept improving to round 7, each by refining one lineage of mechanisms (singleton/distinctiveness priors, isolation/surprisal, crowding/chromatic discrimination); none improved at round 8.

Recovery succeeded in all four cells without internet access: the exported models are 0.0012-0.0053 RMSE from the ground truth against 0.048-0.049 for the best seed, and no seed would pass the verdict.

CV over training conditions does not always predict transfer: in real_rep3 grouped CV pruned feature_surprisal_listener 381.8 nats behind the winner, yet it is ~12 lpd ahead on held-out conditions; real_rep2's final CV is ~140 below the other replicates while its held-out gain is the second largest.
decisions: Three recovery cells crashed just after midnight on an arviz daily-marker collision between concurrent fit children; resumed the same morning from their last scored step (no code change).
Partial results were committed before the sweep ended, at the PI's request (29fa52c, fb6a32d).
Sherlock's stale pre-rewrite main was not pushed to GitHub: its content is all on main, and pushing it would restore an unredacted Prolific-style ID.
